_meta.description: D6 fixtures for google-antigravity / readonly-state-agent-context. Every prompt is two legs: the built-in `get_app_context` read, then the answer (src/agents/app_context.py).
_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: google-antigravity staging: the Antigravity Go harness owns the conversation history and never sends role:"tool" messages, so hasToolResult/toolCallId never fire and every leg is staged on turnIndex (aimock's count of assistant messages; +2 per tool round-trip, +1 per text answer). The highest turnIndex <= assistantCount wins, so each leg carries every absolute position a test reaches it from: a fresh thread (0/2...) AND its slot in the probe's single-thread sequence.

fixtures._comment: 'Who am I?' pill, and the single turn of d5-readonly-state-context.ts (which only checks that the request body carries the name it typed and that the turn settles). The model first calls the adapter's silent built-in `get_app_context` (no TOOL_CALL events, no card), which returns the page's useAgentContext entries. readonly-state-agent-context.spec.ts expects the answer to start with "I see you're Atai".
